channel.title: Old Cars Weekly - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Old Cars Weekly (oldcarsweekly.com)

item.title: From garage to die-cast car: 2026 Hot Wheels Legends Tour now accepting entries worldwide
item.description: Mattel, Inc. announced that submissions are now open for Mattel’s Hot Wheels™ Legends Tour.

item.title: Hollywood hits the Orlando Auto Museum: Leonardo DiCaprio’s screen-used car from One Battle After Another now on display
item.description: The Orlando Auto Museum at Dezerland Park announced the arrival of the screen-used 1993 Nissan Sentra driven by Leonardo DiCaprio in the film, now on public display.

item.title: Car of the Week: 1966 Pearson-Owens 1966 Charger
item.description: Prepping for a NASCAR return: The Pearson-Owens 1966 Charger.

item.title: Charlotte Motor Speedway's AutoFair to host rare classics, muscle cars and unique rides on April 9-11
item.description: Fans of Charlotte Motor Speedway's AutoFair will experience nearly a century of automotive history as hundreds of vehicles fill the infield at AutoFair, April 9-11.

item.title: Corvettes at Carlisle 2026 to salute the red, white and blue with ever-popular all-Corvette American flag
item.description: During Corvettes at Carlisle (August 27-29) over 100 red, white, and blue Corvettes will come together to showcase the symbol of America.

item.title: Ex-Jim Clark and Dan Gurney historic Ford-powered race cars to headline inaugural Bonhams|Cars Laguna Seca Sale
item.description: Bonhams|Cars confirmed two historically important Ford-powered Indy and CanAm race cars will headline The Laguna Seca Auction at WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca, part of Monterey Car Week, on August 13.

item.title: Cars, boats, and Monaco Grand Prix weekend headline Chesapeake Bay Motoring Festival June 6-7
item.description: The 10th annual Chesapeake Bay Motoring Festival returns June 6–7, 2026, to the waterfront lawns of the Kent Island Yacht Club.

item.title: The Silent Knight comes out on top at Amelia Island
item.description: The JBS Collection’s 1928 Minerva AF Transformable Town Car was awarded First in Class in the Sleeve Valve class at The Amelia Concours d’Elegance, held March 5-8 on Amelia Island.

item.title: Rolling jack stands: A cost cutting alternative
item.description: For longer than I can even recall, I’ve used the same set of four General Motors space-saver spares as rolling jack stands.

item.title: Car of the Week: 1938 Chevrolet 1-1/2-ton stake bed
item.description: The sentimental stake bed: 1938 Chevrolet 1-1/2-ton still working for its first family.
